import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.CechHigherDirectImageUnconditional

universe u
open CategoryTheory Limits
namespace AlgebraicGeometry
open Scheme.Modules
variable {X : Scheme.{u}}

-- THE ADJUNCT OF pushPullMap: the pushPullMap analogue of `bareBC_pullback_counit`.
-- Under `p₂^*` and past the `p₂`-counit, `rawPushPullMap` becomes pullback-pseudofunctor
-- coherence plus ONE single-adjunction counit -- the mate/unit is gone.
example {Z₁ Z₂ : Scheme.{u}} (a : Z₂ ⟶ Z₁) (p₁ : Z₁ ⟶ X) (F : X.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (a ≫ p₁)).map (rawPushPullMap a p₁ (a ≫ p₁) rfl F) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (a ≫ p₁)).counit.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (a ≫ p₁)).obj F)
      = (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp a p₁).inv.app
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward p₁).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p₁).obj F)) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback a).map
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p₁).counit.app
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p₁).obj F)) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp a p₁).hom.app F := by
  sorry

end AlgebraicGeometry

import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.CechHigherDirectImageUnconditional

universe u
open CategoryTheory Limits
namespace AlgebraicGeometry
open Scheme.Modules
variable {X : Scheme.{u}}

/-- STEP 0 (the key counit decomposition, from mathlib's conjugate-equivalence API).
`counit_{a ≫ p₁}` factors through the pullback telescope and the two single counits. -/
theorem counit_comp_decomp {Z₁ Z₂ : Scheme.{u}} (a : Z₂ ⟶ Z₁) (p₁ : Z₁ ⟶ X)
    (d : Z₂.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (a ≫ p₁)).counit.app d
      = (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp a p₁).inv.app
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward a ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward p₁).obj d) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback a).map
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p₁).counit.app
              ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward a).obj d)) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction a).counit.app d := by
  sorry

/-- STEP 1: THE ADJUNCT OF `pushPullMap` (rfl case) -- the `pushPullMap` analogue of the
landed `bareBC_pullback_counit`.  Under `p₂^*` and past the `p₂`-counit, `rawPushPullMap`
loses its unit entirely and becomes pullback-pseudofunctor coherence plus ONE counit. -/
theorem rawPushPullMap_pullback_counit_self {Z₁ Z₂ : Scheme.{u}} (a : Z₂ ⟶ Z₁) (p₁ : Z₁ ⟶ X)
    (F : X.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (a ≫ p₁)).map (rawPushPullMap a p₁ (a ≫ p₁) rfl F) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (a ≫ p₁)).counit.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (a ≫ p₁)).obj F)
      = (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp a p₁).inv.app
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward p₁).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p₁).obj F)) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback a).map
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p₁).counit.app
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p₁).obj F)) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp a p₁).hom.app F := by
  sorry

end AlgebraicGeometry
